caseNameFull: LANTZ, dba ALASKA TRUCK TRANSPORT, INC. v. LYNDEN TRANSFER, INC.
attorneys: James T. Johnson for appellee Lynden Transfer, Inc., Acting Solicitor General Spritzer and Robert W. Gin-name for the United States et al.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion of Douglas Lantz for leave to intervene and for other relief is denied. The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed.
